name: Jenkins
description: Jenkins is the leading open source automation server, providing hundreds of plugins to support building, deploying, and automating any software project as either a simple CI server or a full continuous delivery hub.
best_for: Serves organizations of any scale that want a free, self-hosted, highly extensible continuous integration and delivery server, from a simple CI setup to a comprehensive delivery hub for many project types.
cons: No official cloud or SaaS offering exists from the Jenkins project itself — infrastructure provisioning, scaling, upgrades, and maintenance are entirely the self-hoster's responsibility, with no vendor support included.

The plugin ecosystem has a high volume of security advisories, frequently affecting a dozen or more plugins at once in a single disclosure, and since most plugins are community-maintained, patch timeliness varies.

Staying current requires an active upgrade cadence even on the stable LTS track, which ships incremental releases roughly every 4 weeks with only important bug and security fixes — meaning security fixes still require regular manual upgrades, not a hands-off subscription.
features: Hundreds of plugins integrating nearly every CI/CD toolchain component
Web-based configuration UI with real-time error checking and built-in help
Distributed builds that spread work across multiple machines and platforms
Self-contained Java program that is ready to run out of the box
Pipeline-as-code support for defining delivery pipelines in version control
Free and open source with no licensing cost

alternatives.name: CircleCI
alternatives.description: A cloud, self-hosted-runner, and on-premise CI/CD platform for building, testing, and deploying software.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a managed CI/CD platform without maintaining their own server.

alternatives.name: GitLab
alternatives.description: An end-to-end DevSecOps platform spanning planning through deployment and security.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting source control and CI/CD in one consolidated platform.

alternatives.name: GitHub
alternatives.description: A developer platform for hosting code and automating workflows via GitHub Actions.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want CI/CD built directly into the same platform that hosts their code.
